failureMessage: the vendor set ships a pack only when declared, so a cross-pack import crashes every consumer that vendors one pack without the other
fix: declare the dependency (requires) and pass configuration, move the shared helper into engine/checks/helpers, or accept the import with a reason in .claudinite-settings.json

forbidReferences.reason: a pack imports only its own files, the engine surface, and the tasks pack's published shared-code/ — abilities otherwise cross pack boundaries through declaration and configuration, never imports; a pack's updates/ is carved out because no vendor set carries it, so an import there cannot crash a consumer (#1317)
